Leaders and households around Raseiniai organized through kin and neighboring ties. A campaign required decisions on people, food and home defense. Taking too many workers threatened the harvest; leaving too few guards exposed families and animals. Fighters needed food and animals, moving differently with booty on return. Coordinated movement depended on messages, relationships and accepted risks.

Leaders and households around Raseiniai organized through kin and neighboring ties. A campaign required decisions on people, food and home defense. Taking too many workers threatened the harvest; leaving too few guards exposed families and animals. Leaders sought people through purposes, shares and defense arrangements. Heavy kin losses weakened later musters, and failed distributions damaged authority.

Leaders and households around Raseiniai organized through kin and neighboring ties. A campaign required decisions on people, food and home defense. Taking too many workers threatened the harvest; leaving too few guards exposed families and animals. A household supplying fighters lost labor for fields, animals and repairs. Booty could help, but delay, wounds and animal losses burdened kin and made shared work important.
